explication: Octo-Fiesta is a Subsonic-compatible proxy for Navidrome: a client request is authenticated and handled by the Subsonic controller, which serves local results through the proxy or searches a configured provider and downloads missing tracks for streaming and later local availability. Its other documented capabilities include provider-backed search and playlists, synced lyrics, and quality-aware downloads. Provider implementations and most runtime wiring were not excerpted, so provider links below rely on README documentation; unsampled details are not inferred.
